figurative_meaning_en: The most excellent gem (the central or most valued person in society)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সমাজের মধ্যমণি হিসেবে তাকে সকলে সম্মান করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is regarded as the central gem of society by everyone.
His mother is the central gem of the family.
note: Often used to highlight someone's indispensable role in a community or group
